result.summary: Step 1 diagnosis PASS. Defect category A (production logic error) confirmed at src/event_store/store.zig:449. Root cause verbatim from code: append() acquires conn at line 277 with defer release at line 281; line 306 BEGIN; line 435 ROLLBACK on duplicate-detection (insert_rows.rows.len == 0); line 449 then nests self.pool.acquire() for the dup-lookup query while the first conn is still held in scope. Full audit of 6 pool.acquire() sites (lines 277, 555, 662, 720, 891, 951) confirms only the append function nests a second acquire inside a held lease. Fix shape: drop dup_conn; reuse the already-held conn (which is rolled-back at line 435 so it is no longer in a transaction and is safe to issue a SELECT on) for both the events-table lookup and the events_archive-table lookup. No error-set change required (StoreError.PoolExhausted remains a valid variant for the initial acquire() failure at line 277). No public signature change. Routing to CODE-DESIGNER (Step 2).
